description: Manifest of xUnit + Pester .tmpl files emitted into each generated wrapper's tests/<TestProjectName>/ directory. The web-api-discovery codegen pipeline (scripts/codegen/tests-emit.js) substitutes the tokens below and emits one ClientTests.<Group>.cs per resource group and one ToolsTests.cs (with [Fact] bodies injected via the {{Facts}} token). Tests in tests/tests-templates.Tests.ps1 enforce manifest <-> body parity.

tokens.ProjectName: PascalCase wrapper name, e.g. ExampleEx. Matches the wrapper csproj.
tokens.Namespace: Root .NET namespace of the wrapper, e.g. Example. Test code lives under {Namespace}.Tests.
tokens.Facts: Pre-rendered block of [Fact] methods (emitted by tests-emit.js: per resource group for ClientTests, one per MCP tool for ToolsTests). Empty string in manifest-parity tests.
tokens.ExpectedTools: One PowerShell hashtable per MCP tool, one per line (e.g. '        @{ Name = "get_me"; Method = "GetMeAsync"; ReadOnly = $true; Destructive = $false; Idempotent = $true }'). Built from the captured endpoints and baked into Mcp.Tests.ps1, which starts the server and compares them with its answer to tools/list.
